patch_description: Key idea: allocate expressive three-qubit ZZZ motifs explicitly to each of the eight tic‑tac‑toe winning lines, while keeping local single‑qubit rotations grouped by geometric symmetry and keeping two‑qubit CRZ entangling separated into ring and radial (center) couplings. This concentrates high-order entangling power exactly where the game semantics live (winning lines), improving discriminative capacity for cross/circle/draw while keeping the per-block parameter budget compact (13 params/block => 78 total parameters). Removing CCRZs and merging final per-qubit rotations reduces circuit depth and gate count, which should reduce overfitting and the train-test gap while keeping or improving validation/test accuracy. The configuration preserves the required feature map, re-uploading schedule, measurement mapping and training loop.
